items.title: Kraft Heinz (NASDAQ:KHC) Beats Q2 CY2026 Sales Expectations
items.summary: Packaged foods company Kraft Heinz (NASDAQ:KHC) reported Q2 CY2026 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, but sales fell by 1.4% year on year to $6.26 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.56 per share was 5.6% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
